page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head at top with page number at left; catchword "Libri" at lower right. Faint show-through from the reverse page appears in the background and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: Levamento esse. Relevare curam. Mitigare laborem. Levationi mihi est aliquid. Allevare onus. Remittere de, Cic. Levare alicui dolorem, Virg. Levamentum praestare. Collevat aliqua herba renes, Plin. Laxare aliquid ex studio, Sen. Exonerare animum solicitudine, Curt.
Levidensis pannus &c.] Rarum textum, Quint. Ralla tunica (a rarus) Non. Rarum cribrum, Ovid. Rara retia, Virg.
Levis] Perleve momentum. Leviculus, levidense munus, Cic. Leviusculus, Plin. Levior tipula, subere, Er.
Leviter] Duobus digitis. Primoribus, supremis labris, Summis digitis. Strictim. Levi brachio & molli. Per transfennam aspicere, Cic. Suspensa manu. Superficie tenus.

Lex] Lex regula juris & injuriae. Decretum, Scitum, Institutum, juris publici. Regula, norma, praescriptio rationis, naturae. Sanctiones foederum, Cic. Rogatio. Promulgatur ab eo rogatio de mea pernicie, Id.
Lex Dei] Lex divina & coelestis, Cic. Decalogus. Decem verba, Isid. Lex divina per Mosen data. Vetus testamentum. N.T. Praecepta Deum, Virg.
Legi communi pare] Publica via ingredi.
Ad legem vivere] Extra circinum & regulam nescire quicquam.

Libenter] Animo libentissimo facere aliquid. Animo gaudenti ac libenti. Libentissime. Perlibenter. Propensè. Non repugnanter. Non gravatè. Magnâ, summâ voluptate, Cic. Volenti animo agere, Sallust. Propenso animo, Liv. Lubens, Ter. Studiosè ludere pilâ, Cic. Ex animo facere, Sallust. Aventer suscptus, Amm. Lubenter, Plaut. Enixè, Perofficiosè, Perstudiosè, Cic. Libenter, vide plus in Lubenter.
Liber, bri] Pellicula arboris interior. Membrana tenuis arborum inter corticem & lignum, Isid. Tunica, Plin. Torus, Col.
Libri] Codices. Muti Magistri, Gell. Muti Praeceptores.

page.notes: The running head and the catchword are read from a low-contrast scan; the reverse-page show-through is ignored. Some words of the first line are doubtful (e.g. "Levamento esse" may be "Levamento esse" as printed, with "esse" partly worn). The running head text is uncertain and is a reconstruction; the printed head shows "LE. LI." in capitals. Entries with abbreviated authorities are copied as printed.
